reels.recommendation_summary: Their favorite photo spots across the parks: Grand Teton sunrise (Schwabacher Landing, Mormon Row), Bryce sunrise (Inspiration Point, Navajo Loop), Glacier (Going-to-the-Sun Road, Highline, Garden Wall, Grinnell Glacier), Rainier sunrise (Fremont Lookout, then Burroughs), White Sands Backcountry at golden hour, Capitol Reef's Cathedral Valley, Badlands golden hour (Hay Butte), Yosemite's Glacier Point in early light, Death Valley (Mesquite Flat sunrise, Zabriskie sunset), Hoh Rainforest early (Hall of Mosses), Shenandoah (Bearfence sunrise, Hawksbill sunset), Grand Canyon (South Kaibab sunrise, Hopi Point sunset), Lassen's Volcanic Scenic Byway stops — plus Hurricane Ridge at sunset (no pin). Five new pins added; attached as a source on 22 places.

reels.title: 7 National Parks, 1 epic road trip — the Southwest
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Seven national parks, one epic Southwest road trip: Grand Canyon, Arches, Canyonlands, Capitol Reef, Bryce, Zion and Great Basin. Their advice: at least 14 days (September best, May also good); a 10-day version skips Great Basin and a day from Capitol Reef; the Utah Mighty 5 alone fits in one week. Named highlights attached: Delicate Arch and Angels Landing. No new pins.
